args.name: Root propagation and tending
args.function: Provide a learnable practical method to propagate and tend edible meadow roots, if their actual biology permits it, for a renewable local food supply.
args.conditions: A meadow-root plant is visible at (10.1,12) on ordinary soil. Root nutrition is known to be 14 with zero toxicity. Whether these plants can be propagated, and suitable growing conditions, are unknown and must be established through evidence.
args.inputs: Potential inputs include viable root material and suitable soil; exact requirements are unknown.
args.costs: Method, learning time, labor, material requirements and growth time are unknown; none should be assumed free or instantaneous.
args.effects: Enable actual planting and tending only after any required learning and with real inputs and elapsed growth time. Successful growth and harvest must be observed, not granted by this request.

value.summary: Provide a learnable practical method to propagate and tend edible meadow roots, if their actual biology permits it, for a renewable local food supply.

candidates.function: Place one or two whole units of an owned food on the ground as a paired exposure trial, inspect their quantity and decay, end the observation or retrieve what remains.
Plant one owned root unit in a small soil plot as a persistent trial, inspect a plot by direct observation, or take back remaining planted material; resume or cancel unfinished pla

execution.progress: Planting is paid work whose exact job and escrow persist across interruption; resume pays only remaining work and cancellation/death settles once. Inspect and remove are atomic one-round actions.

details.costs: Plant: one owned unspoiled root unit (quantity 1); two work rounds at one energy each, at an unoccupied ordinary-soil x/y within 0.65 plus body radius; supply inputStackId. Resume/cancel use personal processId. Inspect: one round and 0.2 energy, the baseline probe observation of a plot in reach (target). Remove: one round and 1 energy, planter only (target). Tend is unavailable and spends nothing. No tools or water are granted.
details.effects: Completed planting places the real root unit in the plot; it keeps ageing under existing environmental decay while the planter is absent. Plot state records stage, observation rounds, soil moisture and temperature/rain exposure. There is no propagation, growth, harvest or replenishment rule for roots, so a plot never produces food. Inspect records only visible state. Remove returns only the material that physically remains, never a replacement; the emptied plot remains. Cancel releases unplanted material once; death releases it on the ground. Spent effort is never refunded. No reward for planting, inspecting or removing; genuine observed changes use the existing evidence-deduplicated probe feedback only.

packet.access: Omission is not absence. Query abilities, own inventory, knowledge, projects, memory, state or personally observed objects in batches. Ability search/list returns compact catalogue entries; use exact ids for full interface details and applicability. Search results are indexes. Exact queries return one record per offset. All paged records use600-code-unit fragments with zero-based part0..parts-1, consistently in proactive and queried views. Current-scope retained queries are reprojected using these stable pages; original results remain archived. Queries expose no hidden properties, other private records or historical capabilities. Queries do not perform physical trials or award experience. Exact-id queries return a complete record of up to 4000 code units as one value in a single result; larger records keep the paged form.

value.name: Controlled food processing trial
value.function: Place one or two whole units of an owned food on the ground as a paired exposure trial, inspect their quantity and decay, end the observation or retrieve what remains.
value.costs: Start: inputStackId of an owned, unspoiled, nontoxic food, quantity 1 or 2 whole units (default 2), and an unoccupied ordinary-ground x/y within 0.65 plus body radius; two work rounds at one energy each. Resume/cancel use personal processId. Inspect: target trial in reach, one round and 0.2 energy. Retrieve: operator only, one round and one energy. Cancel of an exposed trial ends observation at no cost. No supports, tools, water or fuel are used or granted.
value.effects: Completed setup places the samples at two ground positions 0.2 apart under the same ambient conditions; with one unit there is no matched control. No food moisture, drying or preservation model exists in this world: both samples keep the existing decay rules, so no treatment difference, preserved status, safety certification or extended lifetime is produced. The trial records rounds exposed and marks a 10-round observation checkpoint; ageing continues while unattended and after the checkpoint. Inspect records sample quantity and decay as a personal unverified record. Retrieve returns only the remaining material, never a replacement. Setup interruption keeps paid work; cancel releases reserved food once; death releases it on the ground. Spent effort is never refunded. No reward for starting, inspecting or retrieving.
